name: mangle-temporal
instr:
Could you restore temporal reasoning in our Go copy of Mangle? Implement the remaining `panic("not implemented")` stubs across `ast`, `parse` (including `parse/gen`), `analysis`, `factstore`, `engine`, and `interpreter`.

Use the stub doc comments, the temporal section in `README.md`, and temporal programs in `examples/` as the contract. Support the documented timezone names and abbreviations. Preserve public API names and signatures and keep existing tests passing; private helpers are your choice except for the retained fields. Retain `IntervalTree.root.height` and `Interpreter.knownPredicates` with their existing types and roles. Also retain `Analyzer.decl` as a `map[ast.PredicateSym]ast.Decl` holding the declarations of predicates to be analyzed.

Temporal string methods use variable symbols and `_` for infinite bounds. `Interval.String` renders eternal intervals without an annotation. Other intervals use `@[...]`, one bound for equal endpoints (including variables), and a comma and space between displayed bounds. Append annotations directly to atom text.

Render timestamp bounds in UTC as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Temporal operators determine the direction of duration offsets.

`Interval.Contains` supports concrete timestamps and infinite endpoints. Coalescing adjacency is one nanosecond.

In added non-test Go code, avoid new `init()` functions; `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys/unix`, `golang.org/x/sys/windows`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime
